title: 💠 **Pezeshkian: Regional Countries’ Displeasure Over Our Attacks on Them Is Irrational**
text:
💠 **Pezeshkian: Regional Countries’ Displeasure Over Our Attacks on Them Is Irrational**"

"🔹 They allowed the enemy to attack us from their territory and martyr our innocent people—then they expect us to have no reaction?
